name: Fonts
description: A collection of all the Font objects in the specified presentation.
remarks: Each Font object represents a font that's used in the presentation.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single Font object from the specified Fonts collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or index number of the single Font object in the collection to be returned.

methods.name: Replace
methods.signature: Replace(Original As String, Replacement As String)
methods.description: Replaces a font in the Fonts collection.

parameters.name: Original
parameters.description: The name of the font to replace.

parameters.name: Replacement
parameters.description: The name of the replacement font.
